name: Llywelyn ap Gruffydd to Neil Crud
Barrel Arete LH and Barrel Traverse
Block Crack
description: The hand crack.

name: Bow Front
description: An eliminate. Reach holds in the break. Heel hook the halfway ledge to the right and head up for the top edge just left of the crack.

name: Bow Wave
description: Left hand end at the low bulge. Right hand square incut, left on one of two crimps.

name: Breaktime
description: Start at the large ledge on the right, traverse the mid height break to the left edge and finish at Fridge on the left.

name: Bulger
description: Sit Start. Big move to some questionable holds up and right.

name: Cathcart's Got a Brand New Brodrie
Central Groove
description: Follow the groove

name: Central Wall
description: Sit Start from the holds around the low block. Go up to nice edges through to the top.

name: Cinderella Wall
description: The left hand side of the central facet of the Far Left Wall, don't use holds on the arete. Beginning footholds are small and hard to spot.

name: Clach à Mhoid
description: Large erratic glacial boulder previously used as a meeting place.

name: Clogwyn Du'r Arddu Far West Buttress
Cobra
description: The main crack in the centre

name: Cratcliff Tor
description: Some big rocks

name: Crimpnarris
description: The Scalp bouldering

name: Direct Line
description: Right hand leaning off the crack and left hand on a sharp side pull. Move up into the slopes. Crimp to the top using small holds before the jugs.

name: Durin
description: The face to the right of the hand crack. Begin with one hand in the triangular pocket and the other on sidepulls further right.

name: Dusty Wall
description: The poor wall on the right

name: Edgey
description: Wall left of the Cobra crack. Go straight up

name: Foot and Mouth Made Me Do It!
Fridge
description: Sit start in the low break with the good right-hand pocket. Climb using any feature you find.

name: Gearr Aonach Zig Zags Cliff Scramble
description: This is not a path but a scramble with a large sheer drop on one side

name: Gimli Crack
description: The crack.

name: Gimli Rib
description: The left rib of the hand crack on its left side.

name: Hawthorn Rib
description: The rib right of the tree. Left hand start on a high-ish crimp on the left side of the rib and right hand on any of the sidepulls. There is a good but awkward foothold on the left.

name: Hooby's Dancing Rhythmic Wiggle Sit Start
It's a Family Affair
description: The fractured wall and upper bulge about a meter right of Cinderella Wall.

name: Jam Crack
description: The hand crack

name: Juggy Crack
description: The obvious crack that is juggy.

name: Just a Half
description: The right side of the left wall using the good holds on the central rib.

name: Layback Groove
description: Layback between Thin Wall and Bulger

name: Laying Low
description: The left side of the short wall starting with the hands on a good low right-facing layaway and a thin one directly above.

name: Left Arete
description: Use the left edge.

name: Left Groove
description: The groove to the left of Edgey. Try and avoid pulling on the giant loose block.

name: Mole Hill
description: Start with the right hand on a good hold on the right arete, left hand on a crimp in the middle of the face. Poor footholds.

name: Myopics Buttress
description: Overhanging cliff with sport climbing routes

name: No Fool Like an Old Fool
Off the Blocks
description: Start with your feet on the blocks embedded in grass and mantel up.

name: Oin
description: The crack beginning above an embedded stone.

name: Pinnacle Slab using Right Arête Only
Pocket Rocket
description: Sit start using the pockets to the right of Jam Crack. Go up to the obvious for the right hand. Then use up the arete.

name: Pocket Rocket sans
description: The same beta as Pocket Rocket, but you're not allowed to use the arete or the crack, tiny crimp haven.

name: Poor Wall
description: Go past a triangular ledge

name: Pop of the Tops
description: use the short crack to reach edges in the break. Smear and pop for the top.

name: Rain Face
description: Use the flake crack. Go up the wall using edges and breaks.

name: Sharp Crack
description: The sharp thin crack.

name: Shire Combe Buttress and West Slab
Slope Traverse / Dave's Traverse / BBQ Lip
Small Beer
description: Right of Taster a tiny corner rises above a raised grass ledge. The left side of the left wall of the corner avoiding holds either side of the ribs.

name: Sudoku
description: The right side of the right wall with both hands on a highish crimp and pass slightly right of the gorse patch.

name: Taster
description: Right of Laying Low using highish crimps and not using holds on the rib to the right.

name: That's Enough New Routes for Now
That's Enough New Routes for Now Straight Up
The Wall Right of the Paddy Cave
Thin Wall
description: The narrow wall right of the main crack.

name: Tree Wall
description: Climb past the tree.

name: Trivial Pursuits
description: The left side of the right wall passing left of the gorse patch at the top. Tricky start with the feet.

name: Wyndcliffe Quarry
description: mostly sport routes in the F5-F6C range
